question: When does registration open each day?
answer: Registration desks at ICC **Main Lobby** open from **7:00 AM** daily. Collect your badge, Wi-Fi card, and programme booklet there.

question: What do I need to collect my delegate badge?
answer: Bring your **conference confirmation** (email or QR), a **valid ID**, and the name used during registration. Replacement badges are issued at the Main Lobby help desk.

question: I lost my badge - what should I do?
answer: Report to **Concierge** or the **Main Lobby** registration desk with your ID. A replacement badge will be issued and your old one deactivated.

question: Can I register on behalf of a colleague?
answer: On-site registration is **per delegate**. Colleagues must check in personally with ID. Branch/group coordinators should contact the **front desk** team for bulk enquiries.

question: Is there a dress code for the conference?
answer: **Business / smart professional** attire for plenary and technical sessions. **Cultural Night** invites traditional or smart casual dress. Comfortable shoes are recommended for ICC walking distances.

question: Where is the International Conference Centre?
answer: ICC is in **Maiduguri, Borno State, Nigeria**. Use **Venue map** in the app for halls, or **Maiduguri guide** for GPS directions from the airport or city centre.

question: How do I get from Maiduguri Airport to ICC?
answer: Allow about **45 minutes** via Airport Road → Baga Road → ICC. Delegate shuttles may be arranged for partner hotels - check **Announcements** for the latest pickup times.

question: Is parking available at ICC?
answer: Yes - **on-site parking** with security. Follow marshals at the main gate. **VIP drop-off** is at the lobby canopy. See **Maiduguri guide** for details.

question: Where is the Grand Hall?
answer: **Grand Hall** is the main plenary space - opening ceremony, keynotes, and closing. Open **Venue map** in the app; signage from Main Lobby points the way.

question: Are the venues wheelchair accessible?
answer: ICC has **ramp access** to Hall B and accessible routes from Main Lobby. Request an usher via **Concierge** for personal assistance inside the venue.

question: What are the official conference dates?
answer: **NSE International Conference 2026** runs **28 November - 4 December 2026** at ICC Maiduguri. Full programme in **Schedule**.

question: What time is the opening ceremony?
answer: The **Opening Ceremony & Keynote** is in **Grand Hall** on Day 1. Check **Schedule** for exact times and add it to **My agenda**.

question: How do I save sessions to my personal agenda?
answer: Open any session in **Schedule**, then tap **Add to my agenda**. View saved items under **My agenda** on Home.

question: Are there parallel technical tracks?
answer: Yes - **Divisional Technical Sessions** and workshops run in **Hall A**, **Hall B**, and workshop rooms. Filter by track in **Schedule**.

question: When is the closing ceremony?
answer: **Closing Ceremony & Awards** is on the final conference day in **Grand Hall**. See **Schedule** for time and speaker lineup.

question: Which hotels are recommended for delegates?
answer: The app lists **partner hotels** with distances and rates - including Amada International, Aiba Sport Resort, and ICC Partner Lodge. Open **Hotels** for booking links.

question: Is there a shuttle from hotels to ICC?
answer: Delegate shuttles depart ICC **every 30 minutes** (7:30 AM-9:00 PM) for partner hotels on the **Damboa Road** corridor. Confirm your hotel route in **Announcements**.

question: How do I book a discounted delegate room?
answer: Open **Hotels**, select your property, and use the **booking link** or contact phone listed. Mention **NSE IEC 2026** for delegate rates where applicable.

question: Can I change hotels during the conference?
answer: Yes - you are responsible for your own booking changes. Update your profile **Company** field if needed so networking contacts reach you.

question: Which hotel is closest to ICC?
answer: **ICC Partner Lodge** is about **0.8 km** from the venue. See **Hotels** for all distances and shuttle coverage.

question: What is the conference Wi-Fi password?
answer:
Network: **`NSE-Conference-2026`**
Password: **`engineers2026`**

Also shown on **More** → Conference Wi-Fi and your registration pack.

question: Wi-Fi is not connecting - what should I try?
answer: Forget the network and reconnect, ensure you are on **`NSE-Conference-2026`** (not guest networks), and move closer to lobby APs. Ask **Concierge** if issues persist.

question: Can I use mobile data instead of Wi-Fi?
answer: Yes - **4G/5G** works in Maiduguri. Wi-Fi is provided for heavy downloads and live streaming inside ICC. Enable notifications in the app for announcements.

question: Are meals included for delegates?
answer: **Breakfast** and selected **lunch** items are complimentary during published service hours at ICC catering points. See **Concierge** → **Food orders** for the live menu.

question: How do I order food at the conference?
answer: Open **Concierge** → **Food orders**, choose items from the menu, and select your **pickup location** (e.g. Catering Point B). Kitchen staff fulfil via the admin queue.

question: Are vegetarian or halal options available?
answer: Yes - the conference menu includes **local and continental** options. Ask catering staff at the point of service or note preferences in your food order where available.

question: What time is breakfast served?
answer: Breakfast service typically runs **7:00-9:30 AM** at ICC catering areas. Check daily **Announcements** for any timing changes.

question: How do I meet other delegates?
answer: Enable **Visible in networking directory** on your **Profile**, then browse **Networking**. You can send **direct messages** or join **room chats**.

question: Can I hide my profile from the directory?
answer: Yes - turn off **Visible in networking directory** in **Profile** → Save. You can still message people you have already connected with.

question: How do I update my job title and company?
answer: Go to **More** → **Profile**, edit **Title**, **Company**, and **Bio**, then tap **Save profile**. Changes appear in networking search.

question: Is there a Young Engineers Forum?
answer: Yes - see **Young Engineers Forum** in **Schedule** (Workshop Room 1, Day 1). A mentorship and career pathways session for early-career engineers.

question: What is the conference emergency hotline?
answer: Call **+2348009876543** (24/7 operations desk). Full contact list in **Emergency**, including first aid and venue security.

question: Where is first aid at ICC?
answer: **ICC first aid** station is next to **Hall A** (8 AM-10 PM). Tap **Emergency** in the app for the direct line.

question: What is the national emergency number in Nigeria?
answer: Dial **112** for national emergency services. For conference-specific support, use **+2348009876543** first so ICC ops can assist.

question: Who do I contact for venue security?
answer: **Venue security** office is inside ICC - see **Emergency** for the direct line. Report lost items and access issues there or via **Concierge**.

question: When is Cultural Night?
answer: **Cultural Night** is on **Day 4** in the **Courtyard** - live performances, guest artistes, and a delegate reception. See **Schedule** for times.

question: What is the spouses programme?
answer: The **Spouses Sub-Committee** hosts visits and cultural activities, including a **University of Maiduguri** tour. Check **Announcements** for departure times.

question: What is the conference theme?
answer: **Engineering Innovation for Enhanced Security and Sustainable National Development** - led by **Engr. Mohammed Kabir Wanori, FNSE**. More on **About NSE**.

question: What can I do in Maiduguri between sessions?
answer: See **Maiduguri guide** for nearby restaurants, ATMs, Monday Market, and the university visit. Shuttle and safety tips are listed there.

question: How do I request an usher inside the venue?
answer: Open **Concierge** → **Request usher**, enter your **location** (e.g. Main Lobby), and describe what you need. Front desk staff are dispatched from the queue.

question: What is the 5-day conference schedule outline?
answer:
**Dates: Monday 30th Nov – Friday 4th Dec, 2026**
• **Day 1 (Mon 30 Nov):** Arrival, Registration, Presidential Cocktail & Fellowship Conferment (8am - 6pm)
• **Day 2 (Tue 1 Dec):** Opening Ceremony, Exhibition Launch & 1st Plenary Session (8am - 6pm)
• **Day 3 (Wed 2 Dec):** 2nd Plenary Session, Group Dynamics Competitions, Welfare & Cultural Night (8am - 6pm)
• **Day 4 (Thu 3 Dec):** Closing Ceremony, Annual General Meeting (AGM), Annual Dinner & Gala Night (8am - 9pm)
• **Day 5 (Fri 4 Dec):** Industrial Visits, Spouses Heritage Tour & Delegate Departures
